items.title: Build a Minimal WebMCP Agent with Playwright and Gemini
items.author: Daniel Balcarek
items.rawContent: WebMCP lets a web page expose tools that AI agents can discover and execute inside the browser. That...
items.summary: 本文是一篇实操性教程，指导读者如何使用 Playwright 和 Gemini 构建一个最小化的 WebMCP 代理，使 AI 能在浏览器中自动发现并调用网页暴露的工具。内容聚焦于 AI 代理与前端工具协议的集成实践。
items.summaryEn: This is a hands-on tutorial guiding readers to build a minimal WebMCP agent using Playwright and Gemini, enabling AI agents to discover and execute tools exposed by web pages directly in the browser. It focuses on practical integration of AI agents with frontend tooling protocols.
items.titleEn: Build a Minimal WebMCP Agent with Playwright and Gemini

items.title: Semantic Observability: Engineering Reliability for Production RAG
items.author: Dumebi Okolo
items.rawContent: It is a noticeable thing when a microservice fails. It is either a null pointer exception in a Java...
items.summary: 本文探讨了在生产环境中构建可靠RAG（检索增强生成）系统所面临的可观测性挑战，提出‘语义可观测性’概念，强调需超越传统指标监控，转向对检索质量、生成一致性、上下文相关性等语义层面的工程化保障。
items.summaryEn: This article discusses observability challenges in production RAG systems, introducing the concept of 'Semantic Observability'—a shift from traditional infrastructure metrics to engineering reliability at the semantic level (e.g., retrieval relevance, generation coherence, context fidelity).
items.titleEn: Semantic Observability: Engineering Reliability for Production RAG

items.title: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously
items.author: Zhaojian Yu
items.rawContent: Training language models (LMs) remains a highly human-intensive process, even as frontier language model agents become increasingly capable at software engineering and other long-horizon tasks. A central challenge is that autonomous post-training is not just a coding problem: it requires the agent to repeatedly plan iterations, construct benchmark-aligned data, run stable training jobs, evaluate checkpoints, and preserve experiment state across many hours of interaction. We present AutoTrainess,
items.summary: AutoTrainess 是一项前沿研究，提出让语言模型自主迭代优化自身训练流程的框架，涵盖规划、数据构建、稳定训练、评估与状态持久化等关键环节。该工作直面大模型后训练中自动化程度不足的核心挑战。
items.summaryEn: AutoTrainess is a novel research framework that enables language models to autonomously improve themselves through iterative, end-to-end post-training—including planning, benchmark-aligned data construction, stable training execution, checkpoint evaluation, and cross-session experiment state management. It addresses the fundamental challenge of human dependency in LM refinement.
items.titleEn: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously

items.title: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically
items.author: Youhe Jiang
items.rawContent: Streaming video generation is emerging as a new serving workload in which users interact with long-lived sessions that generate video progressively, chunk by chunk. Unlike offline video generation or typical LLM serving, streaming video generation must preserve session state across active and idle periods, repeatedly schedule ongoing sessions, and deliver each chunk under a tight latency target. This creates two key serving challenges in multi-user, multi-GPU environments: session duration heter
items.summary: TurboServe 是一篇面向流式视频生成场景的新型推理服务系统论文，聚焦于解决长会话、状态保持、低延迟分块输出等独特服务挑战。
items.summaryEn: TurboServe is a research paper proposing a novel inference serving system tailored for streaming video generation, addressing unique challenges including long-lived stateful sessions, intermittent scheduling, and strict per-chunk latency constraints.
items.titleEn: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically

items.title: CausalMix: Data Mixture as Causal Inference for Language Model Training
items.author: Zinan Tang
items.rawContent: In Large Language Model (LLM) training, data mixing plays a pivotal role in determining model performance. Recent methods optimize mixture weights via proxy models, but they rely on the assumption of static data distributions. As a result, when the underlying data pool shifts, these methods require costly retraining from scratch. This limitation restricts their ability to scale seamlessly from small settings to larger data pools and model sizes. In this paper, we propose CausalMix to address thi
items.summary: 本文提出CausalMix方法，将数据混合建模为因果推断问题，以解决大语言模型训练中因数据分布漂移导致的混合权重优化失效问题，提升训练可扩展性与鲁棒性。
items.summaryEn: This paper introduces CausalMix, a novel framework that reframes data mixture optimization in LLM training as causal inference to robustly adapt to shifting data distributions—eliminating the need for costly retraining and enabling scalable adaptation across data scales and model sizes.
items.titleEn: CausalMix: Data Mixture as Causal Inference for Language Model Training

items.title: Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts
items.author: Taewook Kang
items.rawContent: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to perform the same learned tasks under environmental shifts, such as changes in camera pose and shifts to a different but similar robot (e.g., from Panda to UR5e). Adapting these models to the shifted environment (i.e., target domain) often requires training on multiple demonstrations for each task, which are costly to collect. To reduce the burden of data curation and training, we propose an analogy-based method that adapts VLA models under enviro
items.summary: 本文提出一种基于类比推理的‘领域算术’方法，实现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在环境变化（如相机位姿改变或机器人平台切换）下的一次性适配，显著减少对多示例微调的依赖。
items.summaryEn: This paper proposes 'Domain Arithmetic', an analogy-based method for one-shot adaptation of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models under environmental shifts (e.g., camera pose changes or robot platform transfers), reducing reliance on costly multi-demonstration fine-tuning.
items.titleEn: Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts

items.title: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
items.author: Christopher Lindenberg
items.rawContent: World models can enable Model Predictive Control (MPC), but this requires dynamics prediction that is both fast enough for online use and expressive enough to represent uncertain futures. Diffusion models offer a natural mechanism for modeling uncertain dynamics, yet their iterative inference procedure makes them difficult to use for low-latency latent planning. We bridge this gap with Value Diffusion World Models (Valdi), combining end-to-end online training for MPC with a latent diffusion dyna
items.summary: Valdi是一种新型价值扩散世界模型，通过将扩散建模与端到端在线MPC训练相结合，解决了世界模型在低延迟潜空间规划中的推理速度与不确定性表达之间的权衡难题。
items.summaryEn: Valdi is a novel Value Diffusion World Model that bridges the gap between fast, low-latency latent planning and expressive uncertain dynamics modeling by integrating diffusion-based dynamics with end-to-end online Model Predictive Control training.
